rationale: Editorial rarity based on the chosen appearance: silhouette, conceptual novelty, unusual materials, and magical spectacle. These are roster proportions, not encounter odds or power rankings. Each generation uses largest-remainder rounding to whole Billies. Names, approved descriptions, and generation assignments are preserved.

criteria.common: Familiar animals, plants, or simple soft creatures with a clear silhouette and restrained ornament. The approachable foundation of the collection.
criteria.uncommon: A familiar foundation with a distinctive hybrid, material, accessory, or visual joke. More characterful without needing an exceptional magical premise.
criteria.rare: An elaborate silhouette, unusual construction, or prominent magical feature. A stronger visual discovery than the everyday designs.
criteria.mythic-rare: Exceptional transformations, impossible anatomy, or especially striking celestial, elemental, and spirit designs. The visual centerpieces of each generation.

mythicReasons.Azuritusk: A crystalline elephant with faceted cobalt tusks makes a substantial mineral centerpiece.
mythicReasons.Cloudora: A dragon made of cloud and mist gives the generation a celestial creature with an expansive silhouette.
mythicReasons.Ellipso: Three suspended body segments turn an otherwise simple oval design into impossible floating anatomy.
mythicReasons.Emmori: A translucent, two-faced dream body gives this spirit a surreal identity beyond ordinary animal hybrids.
mythicReasons.Glissip: The open harp torso and fingers spanning it turn a sound spirit into a living instrument.
mythicReasons.Halobun: A rabbit spirit whose ears circle its luminous ring body combines familiar appeal with impossible anatomy.
mythicReasons.Hareloom: Ribbon ears stretched into a loom make the entire spirit a delicate weaving structure.
mythicReasons.Jaspurr: Floating jasper shoulder stones and long crystal whiskers elevate this feline spirit into a mineral apparition.
mythicReasons.Lumetti: Confetti plates floating around a luminous core give this energy creature a celebratory, fragmented body.
mythicReasons.Opaluu: An open mineral ring with suspended feet creates a floating crystalline body with no ordinary animal equivalent.
mythicReasons.Orbitot: A miniature planet with its ring acting as a cradle makes the cosmic concept structural, rather than decorative.
mythicReasons.Quasini: A radiant core and twin jets form an unmistakable miniature cosmic phenomenon.
mythicReasons.Sundoggi: Halo ears and paired floating light orbs give the celestial dog a distinctive atmospheric identity.
mythicReasons.Thallumi: A luminous core, translucent seaweed body, and branching ribbon limbs make a striking marine spirit.
mythicReasons.Topazip: A glowing prism, disjointed hands, and suspended shards make an exceptional electric mineral form.
mythicReasons.Umbrelluna: A crescent umbrella bell and long rain ribbons combine moon, weather, and sea life in one dramatic silhouette.
mythicReasons.Anaminii: A second face nested within the belly makes this spirit a distinctive body-within-a-body concept.
mythicReasons.Fibbin: A visible inner silhouette and floating hands make its shapeshifting identity central to the design.
mythicReasons.Fractini: Fern-like limbs that divide into smaller fingers give this fairy unusual recursive anatomy.
mythicReasons.Funderhush: Padded hands cupping a thunderbolt core make the contrast between softness and contained storm energy memorable.
mythicReasons.Lapis: A floating crystal with satellite beads and a luminous eye reads as a compact mineral entity.
mythicReasons.Liyaloom: An open wing frame filled with luminous woven strands creates an unusual structural moth design.
mythicReasons.Medusie: A crown of individual sleepy serpents makes a clear mythological centerpiece with a gentle expression.
mythicReasons.Mobibun: A twisted loop body with one continuous stripe gives the rabbit an impossible topological form.
mythicReasons.Moonsteed: Moon-disc wings and a shimmering tail give the winged pony a clear celestial centerpiece role.
mythicReasons.Nebuloo: A smoky cosmic serpent with star-speckled frills turns an astronomical motif into its whole body.
mythicReasons.Newtrino: Orbital gills and a visible particle core transform a small newt into an exceptional scientific fantasy.
mythicReasons.Orbimoo: A planetary ring, spherical calf body, and crescent horns integrate the cosmic motif into a familiar animal.
mythicReasons.Origamini: A folded-paper dragon with articulated creases makes a strong transformation of material and mythical creature.
mythicReasons.Petalune: A floating blossom built around a crescent core unites floral and lunar forms in a compact centerpiece.
mythicReasons.Sealestial: Constellation flippers, star spots, and a crescent muzzle make the celestial motif span the entire seal.
mythicReasons.Starluma: Glowing star antlers and a comet tail give the fawn an immediately recognizable celestial silhouette.
